extracted.intended_audience: Goodreads members submitting ratings and written reviews
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting star ratings and written reviews on Goodreads so they remain authentic, helpful, and visible to the community. Covers expectations for accuracy, relevance, disclosure, and prohibited content or behaviors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic reflection of reading experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Your ratings and reviews should reflect your authentic reading experience and the book’s content. By submitting ratings you confirm that you have read, or attempted to have read, the book you are reviewing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the full rating scale thoughtfully; your rating should reflect your personal assessment of the book. Goodreads encourages honest, thoughtful feedback that helps others make reading choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanatory, helpful reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews should capture your thoughts about the book and help others understand the reasoning behind your rating.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide context through your reviews when possible, including specific examples and/or constructive criticism to support your opinion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of full rating scale
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage you to use the full rating scale thoughtfully.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thoughtful use helps express nuance in your assessment rather than clustering at one star value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-publication / advance copy reviews and disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-publication ratings and reviews from readers with advance copies are permitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you receive a free copy of a book in exchange for a review, you are required to disclose that in your review. Undisclosed commercial or paid reviews are not allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to book content
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews and ratings must be about the contents of the book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews motivated by commentary that is irrelevant to the contents of the book may be removed. Reviews that link to a blog or other external site without discussing the book are also flagged as inappropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: No harassment, threats, or hate
rubrics_metrics.description: Harassing, threatening, or hateful content in reviews is disallowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such content may lead to removal or reduced visibility of the review; Goodreads values respectful, non-abusive community discourse.

rubrics_metrics.name: No plagiarism
rubrics_metrics.description: Plagiarized content in reviews is prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews must be original to the reviewer; copying others' text without attribution is not allowed and may be removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: No self-promotion or spam
rubrics_metrics.description: Self-promotional reviews and spam reviews are not permitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews that serve primarily to promote the reviewer, products, or unrelated content (spam) will be removed or hidden.

rubrics_metrics.name: No manipulation or inauthentic rating behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Ratings that artificially inflate or deflate a book’s average rating, and unusual rating patterns that suggest automated or inauthentic behavior, are not allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Goodreads monitors for suspicious patterns and may limit the ability to submit ratings and reviews if unusual behavior is detected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moderation, visibility, and removal policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Goodreads will not show reviews and ratings that it deems inappropriate or not of a high enough level of quality, and reserves the right to remove a rating or review at any time for any reason.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By default, your ratings and reviews remain on your profile and in your bookshelves; content is removed or visibility limited only in specific, limited situations. Depending on the violation, Goodreads may remove content entirely or limit its visibility to personal profiles only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting mechanism
rubrics_metrics.description: Members are encouraged to report content they believe may violate these guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported items will be reviewed and action taken as appropriate to maintain community quality; reporting helps Goodreads enforce the standards above.
